newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET - NZ batsmen embarrassed in warm-up.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET - NZ batsmen embarrassed in warm-up.

text.p: HAMILTON, Jan 20 - New Zealand's batsmen were embarrassed by a trio of provincial bowlers in their two-day practice match at Eden Park before this week's first cricket test against England in Auckland, NZPA reports.
The Auckland XI had New Zealand 115 for five in 33 overs as the New Zealand batsmen sought some important batting time going into the test, which starts on Friday.
Opener Bryan Young, who made four and two against England for Northern Districts in their tour match here over the weekend, was bowled by Chris Brown without scoring.
Adam Parore edged a catch to wicketkeeper Jason Mills off Chris Drumm for two, and lefthander Stephen Fleming was caught off Brown for 16.
Justin Vaughan gave Richard Jones a second catch, off Chris Lee, having made 13 and Chris Cairns was caught by Stephen Lynch off Drumm for 24.
Nathan Astle was making the best use of his time at the crease, having reached 39 while captain Lee Germon was on seven.

The match has been designed to give the New Zealand team a day's batting and another day of bowling to compensate for a lack of four-day cricket leading up to the start of the test series. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
